# ============================================================
# PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

storage_account  = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
file_system      = "gpa"
file_name        = "out.GPA Panned to vessel 4.txt"
input_folder     = "bronze/gpa/load"
delta_table_name = "gpa_vessel_moves"
write_mode       = "merge"

bronze_path = (
    f"abfss://{file_system}@{storage_account}"
    f".dfs.core.windows.net/{input_folder}/"
)
delta_path = (
    f"abfss://{file_system}@{storage_account}"
    f".dfs.core.windows.net/delta/{delta_table_name}/"
)

print(f"🔄 File       : {file_name}")
print(f"📂 Bronze     : {bronze_path}")
print(f"📂 Delta      : {delta_path}")
print(f"✏️  Write Mode : {write_mode}")
